answer: The network treats each answer as collateral: incoherent text on the signal scores zero and the identity stops earning. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest horizon a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. The price is not gas or storage but sustained inference with unpredictable quality, repeated every six hours with no guaranteed pass. That makes the relic expensive rather than free. Seal 1na3f.
